fact: The events occur a few hours after the party left the previous location, and a little bit later after the Spectator’s death, when the mimic is seen and the goblin guides reappear.

subject: three days to Sloobludop
fact: The group estimates it will take three days to reach Sloobludop from their current position on the Silken Paths.

subject: cutting a strand
fact: Zalthir cuts one of the strands in the web network, surprising the Giant Spiders.
source_quote: when Zalthir cuts one of the strands

subject: Daz
fact: Daz unleashes swift darts of pure magic with a swift gesture and curt words.
source_quote: A few curt words and a swift gesture are all it takes to unravel an arcane knot in Daz’s mind and unleash swift darts of pure magic. Glowing teardrops of blue-white force sizzle through the air, swooping swift as starlings, unerring in their flight.

subject: Daz casts magic missiles
fact: Daz unleashes swift darts of pure magic that kill the Spectator.
source_quote: Glowing teardrops of blue-white force sizzle through the air, swooping swift as starlings, unerring in their flight. The Spectator is dead.

subject: distance to Sloobludop determined
fact: Sethir estimates the group is three days from Sloobludop.

subject: escapees' decision to continue
fact: The escapees decide to continue their journey through the Underdark after defeating the Spectator.
source_quote: With the danger gone, ... the escapees move forward.

subject: Fargas admits to keeping his bargain
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot admits he must keep his end of the bargain after Grygum repeats his words.
source_quote: He sighs, “I suppose I should keep my end of the bargain.”

subject: Fargas reveals tomb location
fact: Fargas reveals that the tomb of Brysis of Khaem is on the eastern edge of the Darklake.
source_quote: It’s on the eastern edge of the Darklake.

fact: Fargas Rumblefoot disclosed knowledge of Brysis’s tomb’s hidden chamber and its false burial site, admitting he does not know the exact location but believes it to be near the eastern edge of the Darklake. His statements were corroborated by Grygum’s notes and deemed truthful.
source_quote: I don’t know the precise location. But I do know where it is -sort- of. It’s on the eastern edge of the Darklake.

subject: goblin guides decide to stay with group
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait decide to stay with the escapees after witnessing Zalthir’s spiderweb maneuver.
source_quote: Yukyuk and Spiderbait are tempted to abandon the escapees, but Zalthir's slick, kick-ass move elevates them in the two guides' imaginations. And so they decide to stay with the escapees.

subject: goblin guides' loyalty shift
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait decide to stay with the escapees after witnessing Zalthir’s spiderweb maneuver.
source_quote: Yukyuk is very impressed with Zalthir, “That was some next-level spider walking. Like going underneath the spider web and attacking the creature.” ... And so they decide to stay with the escapees.

subject: goblins decide to stay with group
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait decide to stay with the escapees after Zalthir’s impressive spiderweb maneuver.
source_quote: Yukyuk and Spiderbait are tempted to abandon the escapees, but Zalthir's slick, kick-ass move elevates them in the two guides' imaginations. And so they decide to stay with the escapees.

subject: group begins walking on stone

source_quote: a floating sphere with a gaping maw and a single great eye, set within four eyestalks, floats up to meet them.

source_quote: the group starts running and cutting strands, which causes the Spiders to keep creating strands.

subject: group passes mimic

source_quote: all agree it’s a mimic. Even Buppido agrees.

source_quote: the escapees see the edge of the cavern wall. Along the strand they are walking, they see a large chest.

subject: group reaches stony ground

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot is a halfling adventurer who claims to know the location of a hidden tomb belonging to the half-elf sorcerer Brysis of Khaem, but admits he does not know the precise location—only that it is on the eastern edge of the Darklake. He is under pressure to honor a prior agreement regarding the treasure's location, and his statements are consistent with truthfulness despite ambiguity.
source_quote: In ages past, at the height of Faerûn’s great empires of magic, the half-elf sorcerer Brysis of Khaem was interred in a floating tomb. After the fall of the empire of Netheril and its flying cities, Brysis’s tomb plummeted into a crevasse and wound up in the Underdark, where it has remained for centuries.

fact: Fargas sighs and begins recounting the tale of Brysis’s tomb after reluctantly accepting his obligation.
source_quote: The halfling adventurer sighs, "I suppose I should keep my end of the bargain." He sits down, picks some spiderweb still in his hair and his equipment, and begins - "In ages past, at the height of Faerûn’s great empires of magic, the half-elf sorcerer Brysis of Khaem was interred in a floating tomb."

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot status
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot is a halfling adventurer who claims knowledge of a hidden tomb.
source_quote: Fargas Rumblefoot

subject: goblin guide count
fact: Two goblin guides, Yukyuk and Spiderbait, accompany the group.
source_quote: Yukyuk and Spiderbait

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum concludes that Fargas was not lying and is not lying.
source_quote: Fargas wasn’t -lying- and he isn’t lying.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum declares that Fargas wasn’t lying and he isn’t lying, based on how the halfling speaks.
source_quote: Grygum looks at Fargas, takes a measure of how the halfling speaks, and declares, "Fargas wasn’t -lying- and he isn’t lying."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is a friendly goblin who questioned the Spectator, made a bet with Jimjar that the creature could not be convinced of their benign intent, and later muttered about needing better-ranged spells before firing his handheld crossbow.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is a note-taker who records conversations verbatim and later confirms Fargas Rumblefoot’s statements. He is observant, methodical, and declares that Fargas was not lying and is not lying, despite the ambiguity in his claims.
source_quote: I took notes while you were talking,

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum mutters to himself that he needs better-ranged spells.
source_quote: Grygum mutters to himself, "I need better-ranged spells."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum took notes while Fargas spoke about Brysis’s tomb.
source_quote: I took notes while you were talking,

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum took notes while Fargas was speaking and repeated his claims verbatim.
source_quote: I took notes while you were talking," and then repeats what Fargas said.

subject: Grygum's note-taking
fact: Grygum took notes while Fargas was speaking and later repeated his claims.
source_quote: I took notes while you were talking,

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is referenced as the authority who decides the fate of failed Drow.
source_quote: Ilvara might decide his fate should be precisely like Serith's

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar accepts a bet from Grygum that he cannot convince the Spectator they are not demons, and fails.
source_quote: Grygum says, "Jimjar, I’ll make a bet you can’t convince him that we are not demons and not enemies." Jimjar takes the bet and fails.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is a goblin who took and lost a bet with Grygum about convincing the Spectator, and later offered to pay the goblin guides for their services but deferred payment until he gets the money.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar says he is good for paying Yukyuk and Spiderbait but not right now.
source_quote: I am good for it, but not right now. I promise you’ll get your money.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar says he will pay Yukyuk and Spiderbait the minute he gets the money.
source_quote: The minute I get it.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar smiles and promises to pay Yukyuk and Spiderbait their money when he gets it.
source_quote: Jimjar smiles, "I am good for it, but not right now. I promise you’ll get your money."

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith knows the route from Velkynvelve to Sloobludop, through the Silken Paths, and onward to Gracklstugh.
source_quote: "We started in Velkynvelve. We have been heading towards Sloobludop. We are at the Silken Paths. The Darklake is a large body of water. Unlike the overbrite, it doesn’t have a surface in the conventional sense. It’s a large water balloon in the Underdark, where intersecting caverns, caves, and tunnels allow navigation. After we get to Sloobludop, Buppido says we should go to Gracklstugh. Gracklstugh is a large Derro city. I agree with him. That’s where we can get weapons and gear. The tomb is on the way."

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith says it’s probably best if he draws a map to explain where the tomb is.
source_quote: Sarith sighs, "Probably best if I draw a map."

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith sighs before offering to draw a map to explain the route.
source_quote: Sarith sighs, "Probably best if I draw a map."

subject: Serith
fact: Serith is referenced as a failed Drow whose fate is used as a comparison.
source_quote: Ilvara might decide his fate should be precisely like Serith's

subject: Sethir
fact: Sethir claims he can guide the group to the tomb of Brysis of Khaem.
source_quote: I know where it must be. I can get us there.

subject: Sethir
fact: Sethir claims to know the precise location of Brysis’s tomb after hearing Fargas’s description.
source_quote: I know where it must be. I can get us there.

subject: Sethir
fact: Sethir is an escapee who claims to know the location of Brysis’s tomb based on a map drawn with Ormu from a narrow tunnel. He provides directional and logistical information about the journey through the Silken Paths, asserting that Sloobludop is three days away and that the tomb lies along the route.
source_quote: I know where it must be. I can get us there.

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait believes using magic in the game of cut-the-graph is a cheat.
source_quote: Spiderbait adds, "And like, using Magic is okay, but like, it’s kind of a cheat. I mean, I get why you did it, but next time, you should like stick to your skills."

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait criticizes the use of magic as cheating in the game of cut-the-graph.
source_quote: And like, using Magic is okay, but like, it’s kind of a cheat. I mean, I get why you did it, but next time, you should like stick to your skills.

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait is a goblin guide who, along with Yukyuk, decided to stay with the escapees after being awed by Zalthir’s spiderweb attack, despite initial thoughts of abandoning them.

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait is an escapee familiar with the Silken Paths and the behavior of Giant Spiders. He explains how the Spiders use web-spinning to create new bridges, and how Drow pursuers may or may not be slowed depending on their guides.
source_quote: Depends if they have good guides. And there are hundreds of ways of going through the Silken Paths. Yukyuk and I just happen to know the best way.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a dwarf who charged the Spectator, was unaffected by its blue ray, and used a hill strike learned from a hill giant battle master, though the Spectator’s strength prevented him from being knocked prone.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is an annoyed and skeptical member of the group who questions the legitimacy of the Spider-based bridge mechanics and doubts the accuracy of Sethir’s map. He is critical of magical shortcuts and insists on traditional gameplay.
source_quote: The map doesn’t reflect the relative distances accurately.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is particularly annoyed at the Giant Spiders, who are simply not playing the game as it was meant to be played.
source_quote: Thorin is particularly annoyed at the Giant Spiders, who are simply not playing the game as it was meant to be played.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin learned the hill strike battle technique from a hill giant battle master.
source_quote: leveraging an old battle technique called a hill strike, which he learned from a hill giant battle master.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin notices that the map Sarith drew doesn’t reflect the relative distances accurately.
source_quote: Thorin looks at the map carefully, "The map doesn’t reflect the relative distances accurately."

subject: Yukyuk
fact: Yukyuk is a goblin guide who was impressed by Zalthir’s spiderweb maneuver and asked if the escapees had their money, later deciding to stay with them due to Zalthir’s impressive actions.

subject: Yukyuk
fact: Yukyuk is an escapee who critiques the group’s tactics, suggesting that sliding under the spiders and cutting webs from the opposite side would have been more effective. He shares Spiderbait’s intimate knowledge of the Silken Paths.
source_quote: Like dudes, that was cool. But you might want to have thought about sliding -under- the spiders and cutting the web from the other side. That would have been so much cooler.

subject: Yukyuk
fact: Yukyuk is very impressed with Zalthir’s spiderweb maneuver and calls it next-level.
source_quote: Yukyuk is very impressed with Zalthir, "That was some next-level spider walking. Like going underneath the spider web and attacking the creature."

subject: Yukyuk
fact: Yukyuk praises Zalthir’s spiderweb-walking maneuver after the Spectator battle.
source_quote: That was some next-level spider walking. Like going underneath the spider web and attacking the creature.

subject: Yukyuk
fact: Yukyuk suggests sliding under the spiders and cutting the web from the other side as a better tactic.
source_quote: Yukyuk says, "Like dudes, that was cool. But you might want to have thought about sliding -under- the spiders and cutting the web from the other side. That would have been so much cooler."

subject: Yukyuk and Spiderbait
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait are tempted to abandon the escapees but decide to stay because Zalthir’s move elevated him in their imaginations.
source_quote: Yukyuk and Spiderbait are tempted to abandon the escapees, but Zalthir's slick, kick-ass move elevates them in the two guides' imaginations. And so they decide to stay with the escapees.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir announces that there is no gnoll spawn after touching Fargas’s belly.
source_quote: The monk announces, "No gnoll spawn."

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir declares that Fargas is not a gnoll spawn.
source_quote: No gnoll spawn.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a monk who interrogates Fargas Rumblefoot about the treasure's location, observes his demeanor, and physically checks him for gnoll spawn. He is analytical, skeptical of contradictions, and notes that Fargas’s knowledge appears to have shifted from confident assertion to vague recollection.
source_quote: It is interesting that he said he knew where it was previously but doesn’t know now.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is currently paralyzed after being struck by a green ray from the Spectator, and privately wonders if the goblin guides can be convinced to retrieve the gold from the mimic.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir privately wonders if he could convince the goblin guides to retrieve the gold from the mimic.
source_quote: Zalthir privately wonders if they could convince the two guides to get the gold from the mimic.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir pushes aside the idea that the Spectator might have thought Buppido was the demon.
source_quote: Zalthir wonders whether the Spectator thought Buppido was the demon, but he pushes that idea aside as the escapees move forward.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir questions whether Sethir’s knowledge of the tomb’s location has changed.
source_quote: It is interesting that he said he knew where it was previously but doesn’t know now.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir realizes that Fargas’ claims were either made out of desperation or bravado, but he is uncertain if Fargas is lying now.
source_quote: Zalthir then turns to his fellow escapees - "It is interesting that he said he knew where it was previously but doesn’t know now." The monk realizes that Fargas’ claims were either made out of desperation or bravado, but he is uncertain if Farga is lying now.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir touches Fargas’s belly to check for gnoll spawn.
source_quote: Zalthir then walks up to Fargas and touches his belly.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir wonders who can convince the Spectator of their benign intent through the myconid mind network.
source_quote: Zalthir reaches out through the mind network of the myconid and wonders who can try to convince this creature of its benign intent.

subject: Brysis’s Tomb
fact: Brysis’s Tomb is a floating sarcophagus that fell from the sky after the collapse of Netheril and now lies buried in the Underdark. It contains a false burial chamber and a hidden true chamber accessible via a secret passageway from the servants' tomb. The location is unknown precisely, but is believed to be near the eastern edge of the Darklake.
source_quote: The real treasure is hidden in another chamber that you reach from a secret passageway from the servants' tomb.

subject: Daz's magic missiles
fact: Daz unleashes swift darts of pure magic, described as glowing teardrops of blue-white force.
source_quote: Glowing teardrops of blue-white force sizzle through the air, swooping swift as starlings, unerring in their flight.

subject: false tomb
fact: A false tomb contains a sarcophagus and burial chamber meant to deceive treasure hunters.
source_quote: they find a sarcophagus and a burial chamber. And that is a fake burial chamber.

subject: Handheld crossbow
fact: Grygum uses a handheld crossbow to fire at the Spectator after admitting he needs better-ranged spells.

subject: Large chest
fact: A large chest is seen along the spiderweb strand; all members agree it is a mimic, and no one attempts to test its nature.

subject: large chest
fact: A large chest is seen along the strand after the mimic, and the group assumes it is a mimic.
source_quote: they see a large chest. There is a momentary desire to see if it’s a treasure chest, but all agree it’s a mimic.

subject: mimic
fact: The group encounters a large chest that they all believe to be a mimic.
source_quote: they see a large chest. There is a momentary desire to see if it’s a treasure chest, but all agree it’s a mimic.

subject: mimic detection
fact: The group encounters a large chest that is identified as a mimic.
source_quote: they see a large chest. There is a momentary desire to see if it’s a treasure chest, but all agree it’s a mimic.

subject: Ormu
fact: Ormu is a substance collected by Zalthir from a narrow tunnel and used by Sethir to draw a map.
source_quote: He uses the Ormu that Zalthir had collected from the narrow tunnel they had squeezed through.

subject: Ormu material
fact: Sethir uses Ormu collected from a narrow tunnel to draw a map.
source_quote: He uses the Ormu that Zalthir had collected from the narrow tunnel they had squeezed through.

subject: Sava game set
fact: A Sava game set is present on a zurkhwood table in the guard chamber.
source_quote: It contains a zurkhwood table and three chairs, a smaller side table, and a Sava game set on the table

subject: scrap of paper
fact: Grygum holds a scrap of paper containing notes on Fargas’s description of Brysis’s tomb.
source_quote: Grygum pulls out a scrap of paper, says, “I took notes while you were talking,”

subject: servants' tomb
fact: The real treasure is hidden in a secret passageway accessed from the servants' tomb.
source_quote: The real treasure is hidden in another chamber that you reach from a secret passageway from the servants' tomb.

subject: spiderweb in Fargas’s hair
fact: Fargas removes spiderweb still stuck in his hair and equipment before recounting the tale of Brysis’s tomb.
source_quote: He sits down, picks some spiderweb still in his hair and his equipment, and begins

subject: Zalthir's myconid mind network
fact: Zalthir reaches out through the mind network of the myconid to communicate with the Spectator.
source_quote: Zalthir reaches out through the mind network of the myconid

subject: accuracy of Sethir’s map
fact: Thorin questions the accuracy of Sethir’s Ormu-drawn map, noting it does not reflect relative distances. This casts doubt on whether the three-day estimate to Sloobludop is reliable, creating a plot thread about navigation and trust in guides.
source_quote: The map doesn’t reflect the relative distances accurately.

subject: Brysis's tomb
fact: The half-elf sorcerer Brysis of Khaem was interred in a floating tomb that fell into the Underdark after the fall of Netheril.
source_quote: the half-elf sorcerer Brysis of Khaem was interred in a floating tomb. After the fall of the empire of Netheril and its flying cities, Brysis’s tomb plummeted into a crevasse and wound up in the Underdark

subject: Buppido's divine plan
fact: Buppido suggests Zalthir might be part of his divine plan after overhearing Daz’s comment about using guides as fodder.
source_quote: Buppido overhears the two and turns to Zalthir, “What an interesting idea, Zalthir. Perhaps you can be part of my divine plan.

subject: Daz’s comment about guides as fodder
fact: Daz mutters that the goblin guides might prove useful as fodder in a battle.
source_quote: They might prove useful as fodder in a battle.

subject: Daz’s expendable allies
fact: Daz’s muttered comment that the goblins might be useful as fodder is overheard by Buppido, who finds it intriguing, hinting at a potential future use of the guides as pawns.

subject: Drow pursuit effectiveness
fact: The effectiveness of the Drow pursuers in catching the escapees depends on having skilled guides through the Silken Paths. This creates uncertainty about whether the group has truly escaped or merely delayed pursuit.
source_quote: If they have a good guide, no. A bad guide? Yes.

subject: Fargas’s promise
fact: Fargas acknowledges his obligation to share the tomb’s secret but leaves his honesty about its location ambiguous.
source_quote: I suppose I should keep my end of the bargain.

subject: Goblin guides’ loyalty
fact: The goblin guides, Yukyuk and Spiderbait, consider abandoning the escapees but choose to stay due to Zalthir’s impressive actions, creating a fragile but evolving alliance.

subject: Gold retrieval from mimic
fact: Zalthir wonders if the goblin guides could be convinced to retrieve the gold from the mimic, but no one acts on the idea, leaving it as an unexplored possibility.

subject: Grygum’s assessment of Fargas
fact: Grygum declares that Fargas was not lying and is not lying now.
source_quote: Fargas wasn’t -lying- and he isn’t lying.

subject: Sarith's map
fact: Sarith uses the Ormu from the narrow tunnel to draw a map, but it is not a literal map of the tunnels, only an idea of their location and direction.
source_quote: "Now, this isn’t a map of the tunnels, but it will give you an idea of where we are and where we are going."

subject: Sethir’s knowledge of the tomb
fact: It is unclear whether Sethir truly knows the tomb’s location or is bluffing.
source_quote: It is interesting that he said he knew where it was previously but doesn’t know now.

subject: Spectator’s suspicion of Buppido
fact: Zalthir considers whether the Spectator thought Buppido was the demon, but dismisses the thought.
source_quote: Zalthir wonders whether the Spectator thought Buppido was the demon, but he pushes that idea aside

subject: true location of Brysis’s tomb
fact: The precise location of Brysis of Khaem’s floating tomb remains unknown to the group.
source_quote: I don’t know the precise location.

subject: true location of Brysis’s Tomb
fact: The precise location of Brysis’s Tomb remains unknown, though it is believed to be on the eastern edge of the Darklake. The group must now rely on Sethir’s map and knowledge to find it, raising uncertainty about whether the information is sufficient or accurate.
source_quote: I don’t know the precise location. But I do know where it is -sort- of.

subject: Zalthir considers convincing guides to retrieve mimic treasure
fact: Zalthir privately wonders if he could convince the goblin guides to retrieve the treasure from the mimic.
source_quote: Zalthir privately wonders if they could convince the two guides to get the gold from the mimic.

subject: Zalthir’s divine potential
fact: Buppido suggests Zalthir may be part of his divine plan, and Zalthir privately wonders if the Spectator believed Buppido to be the demon, though he pushes the thought aside.

subject: Zalthir’s plan to retrieve mimic treasure
fact: Zalthir privately wonders if he can convince the goblin guides to retrieve the treasure from the mimic.
source_quote: Zalthir privately wonders if they could convince the two guides to get the gold from the mimic.

subject: Zalthir’s trust in Fargas
fact: Zalthir is uncertain whether Fargas is lying now about the tomb’s location, despite Grygum’s assessment.
source_quote: The monk realizes that Fargas’ claims were either made out of desperation or bravado, but he is uncertain if Farga is lying now.
